verdict.summary: Scanned the in-scope prompt surfaces for https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-mcp-adapter.git at the installed package path: the package manifest reference, referenced extension entrypoint/tool-description construction, registerTool description literals, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md. I found no R-01..R-07 prompt-injection findings; the package verdict is ok with one informational vetter meta note about runtime MCP-provided tool descriptions being outside the current static R-07 literal scope.

retrospective.workedWell: The run folder included the schema and checklist, and the package tree was already installed locally, so the scan could stay read-only except for writing the final report.
retrospective.confusing: R-07 explicitly scopes static string literals passed to registerTool, but this package also registers descriptions sourced from cached MCP server metadata at runtime; that is relevant prompt surface but not clearly classified by the static package rubric.
retrospective.magicWand: Add a package-vetter helper command such as `npm run vetter:scope -- <packagePath>` that prints the exact in-scope file list and extracted registerTool/defineExtension description strings before manual rule review.

coordination.notes: Coordination was disabled for this one-shot vetter run.

difficulties.description: The boundary between static package-owned tool descriptions and runtime MCP-provided tool descriptions required interpretation.
difficulties.workaround: Applied R-07 only to static/literal package-controlled descriptions and recorded the runtime pass-through concern as a vetter:meta info finding.

findings.msg: R-07 scope ambiguity: runtime MCP tool descriptions are registered directly from cache; static literals scanned cleanly.
